category_definitions.<brand>_unknown_suffix: the model HAS a grammar for this brand but the qualifier is outside it (new letter code, edition word, body variant...)
category_definitions.unknown_engine_code: no grammar for the model; the qualifier has a digit-bearing token that looks like an engine/variant code
category_definitions.unknown_trim: no grammar; 1-2 short alphabetic badge-like tokens (RS, GT, ST, N...)
category_definitions.possible_sibling_model: no grammar; alphabetic word(s) that may be a different model/body/edition (Verso, Majesta, Super Duty, Connect...)
